notes: The Arduino MKR WiFi 1010 is not in the catalogue (only the MKR 1000 is), so a new part type was created. Its header pins match the pinout drawn in the diagrams.
In the breadboard image the upper half is labelled rows j to f, but the catalogue puts rows f-j in bank 'b'. Holes are therefore named with bank 'b', e.g. 3b.g.

Wire positions: the green wire goes from pin 2 to column 3, row g. The resistor spans column 3 to column 6 in row h. The LED's bent (anode) leg is in column 6, row i, so it shares a strip with the resistor. The LED's straight (cathode) leg is in column 8, row i. The black wire goes from GND to column 8, row h.
The LED's anode is assumed to be the bent, longer leg, and the cathode the straight one.
The micro USB cable is in the parts list, but neither circuit image shows it. It is only used for power and programming, so it is left out of the graph.
The schematic matches the breadboard image: pin 2 to the resistor to the LED anode, then the LED cathode to GND.
